'''Brolla''' the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] was,<ref name="Mission" /> by [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Working for Brolla" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> seeking to hire someone to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] into the [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system of a [[Brolla's rival|rival]]. Though Brolla did not publicly reveal what he was looking for in his rival's computers, he promised good payment.<ref name="Mission" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one of the two opposing governments in the then-ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion to slice into the rival's computers. The companion's slicing exposed the [[Brolla's right-hand|individual]] serving as Brolla's right-hand as a traitor. They also left behind a [[Computer virus/Legends|computer virus]], which prompted Brolla to pay them a bonus.<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Brolla was mentioned in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the Crew Skill mission "Working for Brolla," though the information about the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Mission" />
